title: BOARDPREP — BATCH 653 CSE REVIEW CLOSURE

currentness.finding: No later controlling scope announcement located; the CY2027 calendar still defers the specific scope announcement. No change to the five areas or Professional/Subprofessional applicability affecting these plans.

plans.proposition_summary: Determine whether two reported rates can be compared when their denominators or observation groups changed; require a comparable base before interpreting a trend.
limitations: Current detailed scope is CSC Announcement No. 03 s. 2026; the CY2027 calendar defers specific scope to a later individual announcement.
No exam weights are stated by CSC.
Flat/shared rows are not counted as native depth.
plans.reason: The fresh gate found the same denominator/rate-comparison proposition already in cse-data-trends (daily rate comparison) and cse-data-interpretation (IDs 6760, 6771, 6772). No substitution authorized.

plans.proposition_summary: Distinguish a necessary condition from a sufficient one in a short conditional argument; test whether satisfying a prerequisite alone establishes the outcome.
limitations: Current detailed scope is CSC Announcement No. 03 s. 2026; the CY2027 calendar defers specific scope to a later individual announcement.
No exam weights are stated by CSC.
Flat/shared rows are not counted as native depth.
plans.reason: The item contrasts classification of sufficiency and necessity; existing logical items ask one-way consequences but do not test the paired rule-type distinction.

plans.proposition_summary: Recognize a graded-intensity relationship between two words and preserve that relationship in a second pair rather than substituting a synonym or opposite.
limitations: Current detailed scope is CSC Announcement No. 03 s. 2026; the CY2027 calendar defers specific scope to a later individual announcement.
No exam weights are stated by CSC.
Flat/shared rows are not counted as native depth.
plans.reason: The existing ten word analogies cover synonym, antonym, guide/result, origin/result, tool/quantity, trait/challenge, role/product, premise/conclusion, collection/member, and map/location; none tests graded intensity.

plans.proposition_summary: Compare two clerical records field by field, preserve leading zeroes and punctuation, and identify a near-match caused by a transposed character.
limitations: Current detailed scope is CSC Announcement No. 03 s. 2026; the CY2027 calendar defers specific scope to a later individual announcement.
No exam weights are stated by CSC.
Flat/shared rows are not counted as native depth.
Clerical Ability is named for the Subprofessional CSE-PPT; do not generalize this plan to the Professional level.
plans.reason: DUPLICATIVE: same-board cse-record-comparison already tests leading zeroes, punctuation/trailing spaces, and transposed characters (including IDs 6438, 6451, 6494, 6498). No replacement authorized.

plans.proposition_summary: Compare two rates only after normalizing unlike time units; distinguish a rate comparison from a raw-count comparison.
limitations: Current detailed scope is CSC Announcement No. 03 s. 2026; the CY2027 calendar defers specific scope to a later individual announcement.
No exam weights are stated by CSC.
Flat/shared rows are not counted as native depth.
plans.reason: The item tests the method of normalizing unlike time units before rate comparison, not computing a new rate; no existing CSE item asks this unit-compatibility rule.

cse.decision_reason: Three exact Batch652 Wave1 propositions passed novelty, source/study and exam-level checks. The clerical plan duplicated existing exact-record work, and the contingent data-trend proposition duplicated existing rate/denominator items. No new REVIEW-derived item was promoted; no numeric threshold was used as a quota.
